plugins.name: Music Visualizer
plugins.description: Spectrum, scope, waveform, radial, particles and pitch visuals for audio-only files. Pick a mode with the dropdown or V.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Skip Intro & Credits
plugins.description: Shows a Skip button during intros and credits found in chapter names (Intro, Opening, OP, Credits, Ending, ED) or set per show. Can skip automatically.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Lyrics
plugins.description: Synced lyrics as a karaoke overlay, from a .lrc file next to the song or from LRCLIB, cached on disk. Radio streams: lyrics for the current stream title.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Subtitle Search
plugins.description: Find and download subtitles from OpenSubtitles (by file hash and name) in the Add Subtitles dialog. Needs a free API key.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Auto-tagger
plugins.description: Identifies songs by their audio (AcoustID fingerprint) or tags, looks them up on MusicBrainz, Deezer, iTunes, Last.fm and Discogs and writes tags, hi-res covers and optional LRCLIB synced lyrics after a preview that shows each field's source. Originals are backed up. Keys optional.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Free Music
plugins.description: Search Creative Commons and public-domain music on the Internet Archive and Jamendo, preview it, and download it to your library with tags, cover and licence attribution. Jamendo needs a free client ID.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Network Streams
plugins.description: Browse Internet radio (radio-browser.info), import M3U/IPTV playlists, keep saved and recent streams, and see stream info (now-playing title, codec, bitrate, buffer). No key needed.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Now Playing OSD
plugins.description: Example mpv Lua script: shows the title on the OSD when a file starts.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: A-B Loop & Frame Step
plugins.description: Set and clear A-B loop points from the keyboard, nudge them by a frame, step frame by frame while paused and see the loop on an on-screen bar.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: First release: A-B loop points, frame nudging and stepping, on-screen loop bar.

plugins.name: AcoustID Tagger
plugins.description: Identifies the playing song by its sound: fingerprints it with Chromaprint's fpcalc, looks it up on AcoustID and MusicBrainz and opens the Auto-tagger's before/after review with the tags and a new file name built from your pattern (for example {artist} - {title}), applied only when you confirm. Uses an installed fpcalc, otherwise downloads the official one (1.3–2.6 MB). Needs your free AcoustID application key.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Download fpcalc when it is not installed

changelog.notes: First release: fpcalc fingerprint (system or downloaded), AcoustID + MusicBrainz lookup into the Auto-tagger review, file name proposal from a pattern.

plugins.name: Chapter Thumbnails
plugins.description: Thumbnail preview while hovering the seek bar and a picture for every chapter in the Chapters tab, generated in the background and cached per file. Alt+H lists the chapters with titles and times. Uses your ffmpeg; without one it downloads Vivi's media ffmpeg build once (about 15 MB, shared with Subtitle Auto-Sync).
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Delete the cached thumbnails of this file
settings.label: Clear

changelog.notes: First release: seek-bar hover thumbnails and chapter thumbnails cached per file, chapter list on Alt+H, system ffmpeg or Vivi's media build.

plugins.name: Discord Rich Presence
plugins.description: Shows the current title, artist and progress in your Discord status. Needs a Discord application ID; Discord must be running on this computer. Ships a small native helper (vivi-discord) that talks to Discord's local IPC.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Discord application ID (create one at discord.com/developers/applications; its name is shown as "Listening to <name>")
Large image key (optional art asset of your Discord application)

changelog.notes: First release as a downloadable plugin with the native vivi-discord helper (moved out of the core).

plugins.name: Equalizer
plugins.description: Equalizer presets (Bass, Vocal, Rock, Night, Flat) and a custom 10-band EQ from 31 Hz to 16 kHz, through mpv's audio filters (ffmpeg equalizer or superequalizer). Alt+E cycles presets, Alt+Shift+E turns it off; the choice is remembered. Independent of the Audio panel's own EQ.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Custom gains in dB, 10 bands: 31 62 125 250 500 1k 2k 4k 8k 16k Hz (−12…12)
Lower the volume by the largest boost (no clipping)

changelog.notes: First release: Flat, Bass, Vocal, Rock and Night presets, custom 10-band EQ (equalizer or superequalizer), anti-clipping pre-amp, remembered across restarts.

plugins.name: Night Mode
plugins.description: Compresses loud scenes and lifts quiet dialogue so films stay understandable at low volume (mpv dynaudnorm / loudnorm). Toggle with Alt+N.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Reports the strength when it is changed while Night Mode is off.

plugins.name: Playback Statistics
plugins.description: Counts time watched and listened per day, with top artists and shows. Kept locally in a small TSV file; Alt+S shows a summary, export as CSV or clear any time.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Remote Control
plugins.description: Control playback from your phone: a web page on your local network with play/pause, seek, volume, next/previous, the queue and cover art. PIN protected; only devices on the local network can connect. Ships a small native helper (vivi-remote) that serves the page.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: PIN (asked once by the phone; leave empty for a new random 6-digit PIN)

changelog.notes: First release as a downloadable plugin with a native helper (moved out of the core).

plugins.name: Scene Chapters & Thumbnails
plugins.description: Creates chapters at scene changes for videos without chapters (ffmpeg scene detection, in the background) and saves a thumbnail for every chapter. Results are cached on disk.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Detect scenes automatically for videos without chapters

plugins.name: Scrobbler (Last.fm & ListenBrainz)
plugins.description: Sends what you listen to to Last.fm and/or ListenBrainz: now playing when a track starts and a scrobble after half the track or 4 minutes. Scrobbles made offline are queued and sent later. Needs your ListenBrainz user token, or your Last.fm API key + shared secret (free) and one browser authorisation.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Last.fm scrobbling and now playing (your API key + browser authorisation), next to ListenBrainz; separate offline queue per service.
First release: ListenBrainz now playing and listens with an offline queue.

plugins.name: SponsorBlock
plugins.description: Skips sponsor, intro, self-promotion and other segments in YouTube videos opened as streams, using the crowd-sourced SponsorBlock database. Segments are marked as chapters on the seek bar; every skip shows a notice and can be undone (Alt+Shift+K). Also works for videos the YouTube plugin adds or downloads.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Categories (space separated: sponsor selfpromo interaction intro outro preview music_offtopic filler)
Show a notice with undo (Alt+Shift+K) after each skip
Also for downloaded files named "… [video id].ext"

changelog.notes: Skip notice with undo (Alt+Shift+K), works for files downloaded by the YouTube plugin ("[video id]" in the name).

plugins.name: Subtitle Auto-Sync
plugins.description: Aligns the current external subtitle to the audio with alass or ffsubsync in the background, then loads the synced copy saved next to the original. Manual offset keys (Alt+Z / Alt+X) are remembered per file. Uses an installed alass or ffsubsync; otherwise downloads alass on first use (3 MB on Linux x86_64, 26 MB on Windows) and, without a system ffmpeg, Vivi's media ffmpeg build (about 15 MB, shared with Chapter Thumbnails).

changelog.notes: Downloads a verified alass (and, if needed, ffmpeg) when no sync tool is installed; manual offset keys Alt+Z / Alt+X remembered per file.

plugins.name: YouTube & yt-dlp
plugins.description: Paste a video or playlist URL (or press Alt+U with one in the clipboard) to list its entries in the playlist, see the estimated size of each quality, and download video or audio only into a folder you choose, with progress toasts. Uses your system yt-dlp and ffmpeg when present; otherwise downloads and updates verified copies: yt-dlp (18–40 MB) from its official releases on first use, Vivi's own minimal static ffmpeg + ffprobe (about 6 MB) only for 1080p+ or audio conversion.
